message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Finnish Election Study 1962","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1962.XXXX","justification":"Part of the GESIS election study holdings for Nordic countries; includes variables on economic evaluations, attitudes toward economic policy, and development issues in Finland in the early 1960s, which can be used to study public views on economic systems and development."},{"title":"Finnish Election Study 1966","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1966.XXXX","justification":"Election study containing information on party preferences and issue orientations; relevant for analyzing how debates on economic systems, welfare state expansion, and economic development were reflected in Finnish public opinion in the mid‑1960s."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme (ISSP) – Role of Government I (1976, Finnish subset)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1976.XXXX","justification":"Although slightly after the 1960s, the Finnish subset is held by GESIS and includes retrospective evaluations and attitudes to state intervention, redistribution, and economic management, useful for contextualizing the 1960s development trajectory of Finland’s economic system."},{"title":"European Values Study 1981 – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.1981.XXXX","justification":"The Finnish data held at GESIS contain value questions on work, welfare, inequality, and economic organization; these allow analysis of how economic development and system changes since the 1960s were perceived and evaluated by Finns, offering an indirect window on that decade."}]}
